name: Terror Trail (discontinued)
summary: "Terror Trail" is a fan game of the popular Meta Quest game "Gorilla Tag" It uses Gorilla Tag's locomotion system. This system is where you use your hands to move. You hit your hands on the ground and depending on how fast you hit you will go up. Your character rig has no legs which lets your arms reach the ground.
